## Current State

Describe the current implementation and its problems.

## Proposed Refactor

Describe the refactoring you'd like to perform.

## Benefits

What does this refactor improve? (maintainability, performance, readability, etc.)

## Risks / Considerations

Any risks, breaking changes, or migration concerns.

## Definition of Ready (DoR)

- [ ] Current state and problems documented
- [ ] Proposed refactor described
- [ ] Risks and breaking changes identified

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Refactor preserves existing behavior (or changes are intentional)
- [ ] No regressions
- [ ] Tests still pass

## Definition of Done (DoD)

- [ ] Code merged
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated if applicable

## Additional Context

Any other context or related issues.
